sermons.title: NEW SONG LIVE PERFORMANCE | HOSANNA BY APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN AND KOINONIA WORSHIP TEAM |09||11|2025
summary: The pastor introduces a new prophetic song titled 'Hosana,' explaining that the word originates from Psalm 118:25-26 and originally meant a cry for help to God before becoming a declaration of praise.
The congregation engages in extended worship through the song 'Hosana,' which is presented as a spiritual weapon and declaration of God's worthiness to be praised by all creation and nations.

The pastor emphasizes that invoking God's names through praise releases His power, opens doors, shifts seasons, and brings miracles, encouraging believers to use this song as a tool for spiritual warfare.

sermons.title: PASTOR NATHANIEL BASSEY AT WORSHIP & WARFARE SERVICE MAY 2026  ||17||05||2026
summary: The service centers on declaring God's faithfulness through extended worship and praise, emphasizing that God's mercies are new every morning and His steadfast love never ceases.
The congregation moves through thanksgiving, high praise, and deep worship, celebrating God as the faithful one who fights their battles and grants victory over all circumstances.
Healing testimonies emerge during worship as participants experience God's power, with emphasis on God's exaltation, His role as the man of war, and the victory that belongs to Him alone.

sermons.title: SOUND OF REVIVAL NIGERIA 2025 WITH  APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN  ||23||11||2025
summary: This is a revival service emphasizing bold prayer, faith activation, and personal testimony where believers are encouraged to press into God's presence for healing, deliverance, and breakthrough.

The service features multiple testimonies of supernatural transformation including deliverance from sexual bondage, miraculous healing from medical conditions, divine provision of employment, and protection from accidents.
Participants are called to prophetic declaration, expectant faith, and active participation in receiving God's abundant blessings on the final night of a multi-day convention.

sermons.title: MINISTER DUNSIN OYEKAN AT WORSHIP AND WARFARE SERVICE MARCH 2026 ||15||03||2026
summary: The speaker emphasizes that focusing on God's greatness rather than problems is the key to victory in spiritual warfare, using praise and declaration as weapons.
Through worship and the chanting of God's names (particularly 'Baruch Hashem Adonai'), believers release spiritual power that shifts circumstances and brings mountains low.
The congregation is instructed to change their approach from prayer to praise, positioning their battles before God and declaring His lordship over every situation through unified sound and worship.

sermons.title: WORSHIP AND WARFARE SERVICE - MARCH 2026 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||15||03||2026
summary: This worship and warfare service emphasizes praise as a strategic weapon in spiritual battle, drawing from biblical examples where worship precedes military victory and God sets ambushes for enemies.
Multiple testimonies demonstrate God's faithfulness in healing, provision, marriage, education, and supernatural intervention when believers combine worship with faith and prayer.
Participants are called to present their entire bodies as living sacrifices of praise, contending for total victory and rest on every side through intimate worship in God's presence.

sermons.title: LET US PRAY - PART ONE (GAINING MASTERY IN PRAYER) LUKE 18:1 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||01|02|2026
summary: The sermon emphasizes the importance of consistency in spiritual growth through prayer, worship, and dwelling in God's presence rather than occasional visits to His presence.
Multiple testimonies demonstrate God's faithfulness in healing, deliverance, and provision, encouraging believers to maintain faith and share their encounters with God.

The speaker teaches that true spiritual transformation comes through sustained engagement with God's word, corporate fellowship, and intentional practice of His presence, which produces gifts like utterance, wisdom, and divine vision.

sermons.title: REST ON ME (EXPLORING THE RICHES OF HIS GLORY) HAGGAI 2:9 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||01||03||2026
summary: The service emphasizes encountering God's presence as a place of intimacy, fellowship, and divine exchange where believers experience transformation, healing, and restoration.
Through worship, prayer, and testimonies, the congregation is encouraged to contend for greater conformity to Christ's nature, enlightenment, and empowerment in their daily lives.
God is presented as a restorer who can heal relationships, return lost time and opportunities, and provide victory over spiritual oppression and life's challenges.

sermons.title: DAY 1 OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY WITH KOINONIA (EVENING  SESSION) ||19||11||2025
summary: God calls believers to respond to His mandate with willingness to pay the price and be empowered for spiritual assignments and ministry work.
The evening emphasizes that divine power and miracles are available to those who surrender completely to God's will and answer His call with faith and expectation.

Participants are encouraged to embrace their spiritual calling, seek empowerment through the Holy Spirit, and prepare for transformation that will equip them to perform signs, wonders, and healing in God's name.

sermons.title: VICTORIOUS BY CHOICE (PROGRAMMING DIVINE POSSIBILITIES) DEUT. 30:15-20 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
summary: The service centers on corporate worship and praise to Jesus as the Lion of Judah, emphasizing His victory over death and the believer's identity in Christ's triumph.
Multiple testimonies demonstrate God's faithfulness in healing, divine provision of jobs, restoration after loss, and supernatural deliverance, encouraging believers to trust God's promises.
The message emphasizes that believers must grow spiritually, bear much fruit, and receive God's word with power through prayer, intentionality, and yielding to the Holy Spirit's transformation.

sermons.title: FREEDOM FROM POVERTY, LACK AND WANT (THE ROADMAP TO ECONOMIC EMANCIPATION) WITH APOSTLE SELMAN
summary: The service celebrates God's faithfulness throughout the year with testimonies of healing, provision, and transformation from congregants worldwide.
Multiple personal accounts demonstrate God's intervention in employment, health, family relationships, and financial breakthrough, particularly in the final month of the year.
The congregation is encouraged to give offerings as seeds of faith, pray for pending prophecies to manifest, and maintain eyes of understanding open to God's will and wonders.

sermons.title: LET US PRAY (GAINING MASTERY IN PRAYER) PART 2 (LUKE 18:1) WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN 08l02ll2026
summary: The service centers on corporate worship, prayer, and testimonies of God's miraculous intervention in believers' lives across various nations.
Congregants are encouraged to encounter God's presence through worship, prayer in the Holy Spirit, and faith-building testimonies of healing, deliverance, and answered prayers.
The message emphasizes that God's word transforms lives, that believers should enlarge their capacity to receive from God, and that personal testimonies validate God's power to the watching world.

sermons.title: SEPTEMBER 2025 MIRACLE SERVICE WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||28||09||2025
summary: This miracle service emphasizes entering God's presence with thanksgiving, expectation, and travailing prayer to receive breakthrough and transformation in every area of life.

The speaker teaches that God's mercy sustains believers and that accessing His river of life brings healing, deliverance, and new beginnings, particularly in the ninth month symbolizing completion and birthing.

Multiple testimonies demonstrate God's faithfulness in providing supernatural provision, healing, career advancement, business success, and family restoration for those who pray with faith and honor God's principles.

sermons.title: WORSHIP & WARFARE SERVICE MAY 2026 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||17||05||2026
summary: The service emphasizes a night of worship and warfare where believers encounter God's glory through praise, prayer, and prophetic declaration to experience total victory and deliverance.
Testimonies demonstrate God's faithfulness in healing, provision, breakthrough, and protection across various life circumstances, encouraging believers to contend for grace and divine intervention.
The congregation is invited to engage in corporate worship, intercession, and personal prayer to access God's power for transformation, healing, and the breaking of spiritual bondages.

sermons.title: DOMINION CHECKLIST (END-OF-YEAR APPRAISALS) 2 PETER 1:21 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN 14||12||2025
summary: This final service of the year emphasizes gratitude to God for His faithfulness, protection, and provision throughout 2025, the year of 'days of His power.'
The congregation is encouraged to approach God boldly, present their needs in prayer, and receive testimonies of miraculous interventions in healing, finances, relationships, and career advancement.
Multiple personal testimonies demonstrate God's transformative power in immigration, health, employment, education, and spiritual growth, inspiring faith for continued blessings into the new year.

sermons.title: APRIL 2026 MIRACLE SERVICE WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||26||04||2026
summary: This miracle service emphasizes faith in God's power and wisdom to bring supernatural healing and deliverance to believers who come with expectation and trust.
Through testimonies of healings, deliverances, and divine provision, the congregation is encouraged that tonight is their night for miracles and breakthrough.
The service calls believers to appropriate God's blessings through faith in the finished work of Christ, the authority of Jesus' name, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

sermons.title: NOVEMBER 2025 MIRACLE SERVICE WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||30||11||2025
summary: The sermon emphasizes God as the 'God of the 11th hour' who can accomplish the impossible at any moment, using Matthew 20:6-8 to show that timing does not limit divine blessing.
Multiple testimonies demonstrate God's power to heal, provide favor, grant immigration miracles, and transform lives through faith and prayer in the ministry.
Believers are called to pray with desperation and faith, believing that God desires their breakthrough and has the ability to deliver it immediately, not gradually.

sermons.title: THE MINISTRY OF HEALING (HEALING TO THE NATIONS) EXODUS 15:26 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN |08|03|2026
summary: The service emphasizes encountering God's presence through worship, prayer, and surrender as the foundation for spiritual transformation and receiving divine understanding.
Testimonies of healing, promotion, and deliverance demonstrate God's power and encourage believers to develop deeper intimacy with Him rather than merely attending services.

The pastor teaches that spiritual growth requires sensitivity to the Holy Spirit across multiple channels—prayer, worship, testimony, teaching, and fellowship—not just intellectual knowledge of God's word.

sermons.title: AUGUST 2025 MIRACLE SERVICE WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||31||08||2025
summary: Gratitude is the atmosphere where miracles, healings, and God's favor flow; believers must learn to thank God deeply and intentionally, not casually, recognizing the weight of His sacrifice and goodness.

The sermon features multiple testimonies of God's miraculous intervention—healing from autoimmune disease, job promotions, visa approvals, deliverance from addiction—demonstrating that God is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all we ask or think.
Ingratitude cuts short the flow of God's grace and mercy, while thanksgiving waters God's work in our lives and opens doors for continued blessing and divine intervention.

sermons.title: THIS IS THE WAY (THE POWER OF DIVINE DIRECTION) NUMBERS 9:23 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN 14||06||2026
summary: The sermon emphasizes entering God's presence with thanksgiving as a foundational spiritual practice, citing Psalms 100:4 and encouraging believers to recognize God's faithfulness and goodness in their lives.

Multiple testimonies of divine healing and miraculous provision are shared, demonstrating God's power to transform circumstances and deliver believers from physical ailments, financial struggles, and spiritual battles.

The pastor challenges believers to mature from spiritual children to sons and daughters through receiving God's word, and to express gratitude not just for answered prayers but for God's continuous protection and provision in daily life.

sermons.title: THEY THAT BE WISE (THE CULTURE OF WISE MEN) - DANIEL 12:3 WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||12||10||2025
summary: The sermon emphasizes personal testimony as a powerful tool for faith, with believers encouraged to share how Jesus has transformed their lives and overcome challenges through his blood and word.
Multiple testimonies are shared of miraculous healings, visa approvals, family reunifications, and divine interventions, demonstrating God's faithfulness and power to work impossibilities.

The congregation is called to trust God completely, cast their cares upon him, and respond with worship and gratitude, while being challenged to give tithes and offerings as an act of faith and honor.

sermons.title: SCRIPTURAL STRATEGIES FOR CHALLENGING TIMES (ROM. 8:35-37) WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||17||08||2025
summary: The sermon emphasizes the importance of personal encounters with God that produce visible, transformative evidence in believers' lives, using biblical examples like Paul's Damascus experience and the woman at the well.

Multiple testimonies demonstrate God's power to heal diseases, break addictions, provide supernatural provision, and reverse generational curses when believers press into His presence and act on His word.

The message calls believers to move beyond passive attendance to active engagement with God's presence, expecting tangible manifestations and lasting change that will impact their families, communities, and future generations.

sermons.title: DAY 2 OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY WITH KOINONIA (EVENING SESSION) ||20||11||2025
summary: God calls, makes, and sends believers; transformation requires the combination of wisdom, faith, and power working together in the believer's life.
Participants are urged to press into God through prayer in the Spirit, yielding themselves to be made and enlarged in capacity for their divine destiny.
Testimonies demonstrate God's power to heal, provide, transform character, and shift circumstances when believers engage faith, prayer, and obedience to God's word.

sermons.title: WORSHIP & WARFARE SERVICE - THE KOINONIA EXPEREINCE WITH APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN ||19||04||2026
summary: The service emphasizes worship as a weapon of spiritual warfare, teaching that praise and worship position believers for divine victory and breakthrough.
Multiple testimonies demonstrate God's healing power, financial restoration, and supernatural provision across different nations, validating the power of faith and prayer.
Believers are encouraged to engage with expectation, hunger, and faith as protocols for receiving God's blessings and experiencing personal transformation and deliverance.
